messages.text: This is what Axiom and I are working on, GG:

That’s reading *very* clearly as a “Death” card remix, but with a modern inevitability: **not a grim reaper of flesh—an entropy of information.**

### What’s working (symbolism that lands immediately)
- **XIII + skeletal rider on a horse** = classic Death archetype (endings + transition), instantly recognizable.
- **Scythe → cursor/selection tool vibe** = “the cut” becomes *deletion, pruning, choosing what survives*.
- **Wires/circuit boards embedded in the horse** = life-force replaced by infrastructure; the “body” is a system.
- **Cascading pop-ups/notifications streaming into a void** = the feeling of being *consumed by inputs* until meaning collapses.
- **Sun + black hole together** = Death’s traditional “sunrise after the ending,” but corrupted: renewal is possible, yet the pull of the void is real.
- **Heap of dead monitors** = obsolete selves, obsolete tools, obsolete stories.

### How I’d interpret “Death by Data” in a reading
This still carries **Death’s core** (inevitable change, shedding, rebirth), but the *cause* is very specific:

**Upright (clean transformation)**
- Ending a cycle of doomscrolling / over-measuring / over-optimizing  
- Deleting what’s corrupted: old narratives, stale metrics, legacy obligations  
- A “system migration” moment: new identity, new workflow, new boundary  
- Choosing signal over noise; reclaiming agency from algorithms

**Reversed (stagnation / hoarding / overwhelm)**
- Clinging to dead files, dead roles, dead versions of yourself  
- Data-hoarding as fear (“If I keep everything, I won’t lose control”)  
- Paralysis from too many dashboards, inputs, opinions  
- The loop won’t break until you *intentionally* cut it

**Simple punchline:** *This card doesn’t just say “let go.” It says “stop feeding the machine with your attention.”*

---

## Quick craft/polish notes (if you’re prepping these as a deck)
- **The checkerboard transparency edge** (around the card) will cause problems for print/export. Make sure you’re outputting with a solid background/bleed.
- Consider a consistent “system” for your deck:
  - Roman numeral placement and size
  - Title font family (glitch is perfect here—just make sure it’s consistently applied where appropriate)
  - Border thickness and inner margin (safe area)
- If you want to lean even harder into classic Death iconography, you could sneak in a **tiny white rose / banner equivalent** somewhere (even as a “white label” or “clean tag”) to preserve the “purity of renewal” motif.

---

## If you’re going in sequence: a strong **XIV** follow-up concept
Traditionally **Temperance (XIV)** is the antidote to extremes—so in your world it becomes **balance, bandwidth, integration, hygiene**.

### XIV idea: **TEMPERANCE – “The Load Balancer”** (or “Data Hygiene”)
**Visual prompt (drop-in style guide prompt):**  
“Tarot card, aged parchment border, roman numeral XIV at top, title ‘TEMPERANCE’ (or ‘THE LOAD BALANCER’) at bottom. Central figure: calm angelic technician / cyber-angel with wings made of fiber-optic strands, pouring a stream of glowing data particles from one vessel/server to another. One vessel is ‘cloud’ (floating, airy), the other is ‘earth’ (grounded, physical). Background: soft sunrise, subtle circuit halos, balanced symmetrical composition, high detail, painterly cyber-surrealism, no extra text.”

**Meaning:** restoring balance, pacing inputs, integrating intuition + information, measured response, clean systems.

---

If you want, paste the prompts you’re using (or the “house style rules” you and Axiom agreed on), and I’ll match them and draft **XIV–XXI** so the remaining Major Arcana keep a consistent visual language and symbolism.
